name: roamux
use_label: Steer your coding agents from a phone
one_liner: Lets you watch and steer coding agents on your own machine from a phone.

text.why: Give a coding agent a long task and you are stuck at the desk until its next permission request. roamux installs a small host daemon that dials out, so an authenticated phone or browser can start sessions, watch progress, approve or deny requests and review changed files. Code, credentials and model keys never leave the machine; the cloud handles only labels and ids. It drives OpenCode, Claude Code or Codex as you already run them; MIT, hosts for macOS and Linux.
text.take: Instead of moving the agent to the cloud, it moves only the cockpit out of the room.
build: An overnight refactor you approve from your phone as it runs
A home machine kept as the agent host while you are out
A team view of agent sessions across several machines

who.situation: wants to leave the desk during long runs
code and keys must stay on the box

start.text: First install and sign in to one of OpenCode, Claude Code or Codex
AGENT_ADAPTER=claude-code roamux host      # or opencode | codex
Then open remote.phyra.ai on your phone or browser and start a New Session

caveat: Host runs on macOS and Linux; Windows is not in the README
The agent auto-accepts file edits, so point it at a git repo
One host serves one agent; run several hosts for several agents
